# evolnets

RevBayes and TreePPL offer models to infer host repertoire evolution,
but no tools to parse the outputs. *evolnets* has the necessary tools to
reconstruct ancestral ecological networks based on posterior
probabilities of interactions.

## Installation

You can install evolnets like so:

``` r
if(!require("devtools", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("devtools")
  library(devtools)
} else {
 library(devtools)
}

devtools::install_github("maribraga/evolnets")
```

## About

The evolnets package provides three categories of important functions:
rates, ancestral states and samples.

- Rates: these functions are used to calculate effective rates of
  host-repertoire evolution:
  [`effective_rate( )`](https://maribraga.github.io/evolnets/reference/events_counter.md),
  [`count_events( )`](https://maribraga.github.io/evolnets/reference/events_counter.md),
  [`rate_gl( )`](https://maribraga.github.io/evolnets/reference/events_counter.md),
  [`count_gl( )`](https://maribraga.github.io/evolnets/reference/events_counter.md).

- Ancestral states: these functions are used to calculate the posterior
  probabilities of host-parasite interactions at internal nodes of the
  parasite tree or at specific time points in the past:
  [`posterior_at_nodes( )`](https://maribraga.github.io/evolnets/reference/posterior_at_nodes.md),
  [`posterior_at_ages( )`](https://maribraga.github.io/evolnets/reference/posterior_at_ages.md).

- Samples: these functions perform calculations for each sampled
  host-parasite network during MCMC: `samples_at_ages( )`,
  `Q_posterior_at_ages( )`, `NODF_posterior_at_ages( )`.

See the full documentation at the [evolnets’
website](https://maribraga.github.io/evolnets/).

# Package index

## All functions

- [`count_events()`](https://maribraga.github.io/evolnets/reference/events_counter.md)
  [`effective_rate()`](https://maribraga.github.io/evolnets/reference/events_counter.md)
  [`count_gl()`](https://maribraga.github.io/evolnets/reference/events_counter.md)
  [`rate_gl()`](https://maribraga.github.io/evolnets/reference/events_counter.md)
  : Calculate the rate of host-repertoire evolution
- [`get_sampled_networks()`](https://maribraga.github.io/evolnets/reference/get_sampled_networks.md)
  : Get posterior samples of networks of interactions of extant lineages
  at given time points in the past
- [`get_summary_networks()`](https://maribraga.github.io/evolnets/reference/get_summary_networks.md)
  : Get summary networks from posterior probabilities of interactions of
  extant lineages at given time points in the past
- [`index_at_ages_samples()`](https://maribraga.github.io/evolnets/reference/index_at_ages_samples.md)
  : Posterior distribution of network structure indices across ancestral
  networks
- [`index_at_ages_summary()`](https://maribraga.github.io/evolnets/reference/index_at_ages_summary.md)
  : Network structure indices across ancestral summary networks and
  extant network
- [`match_modules()`](https://maribraga.github.io/evolnets/reference/match_modules.md)
  : Match modules of different ancestral networks across time.
- [`modules_across_ages()`](https://maribraga.github.io/evolnets/reference/modules_across_ages.md)
  : Evolution of modules: find and match modules across time slices
- [`modules_from_samples()`](https://maribraga.github.io/evolnets/reference/modules_from_samples.md)
  : Find modules in networks sampled across MCMC at specific time slices
- [`modules_from_summary_networks()`](https://maribraga.github.io/evolnets/reference/modules_from_summary_networks.md)
  : Identify modules for each summary network at each age
- [`mycomputeModules()`](https://maribraga.github.io/evolnets/reference/mycomputeModules.md)
  : Modified version of bipartite's computeModules function
- [`pairwise_membership()`](https://maribraga.github.io/evolnets/reference/pairwise_membership.md)
  : Calculate frequency that pairs of nodes fall within the same module
- [`plot_ancestral_networks()`](https://maribraga.github.io/evolnets/reference/plot_ancestral_networks.md)
  : Plot ancestral networks with module information
- [`plot_ancestral_states()`](https://maribraga.github.io/evolnets/reference/plot_ancestral_states.md)
  : Plot ancestral states on the phylogeny.
- [`plot_extant_matrix()`](https://maribraga.github.io/evolnets/reference/plot_extant_matrix.md)
  : Plot a network with modules as an adjacency matrix
- [`plot_index_at_ages()`](https://maribraga.github.io/evolnets/reference/plot_index_at_ages.md)
  : Plot network structure indices across ancestral summary, sampled and
  extant networks
- [`plot_matrix_phylo()`](https://maribraga.github.io/evolnets/reference/plot_matrix_phylo.md)
  : Plot a network with modules as an adjacency matrix, with aligned
  phylogenies.
- [`plot_network_at_age()`](https://maribraga.github.io/evolnets/reference/plot_network_at_age.md)
  : Plot one ancestral network with module information at a given time
- [`posterior_at_ages()`](https://maribraga.github.io/evolnets/reference/posterior_at_ages.md)
  : Calculate the posterior probability of ancestral host repertoires at
  time points in the past (ages)
- [`posterior_at_nodes()`](https://maribraga.github.io/evolnets/reference/posterior_at_nodes.md)
  : Calculate the posterior probability of ancestral host repertoires
- [`read_history()`](https://maribraga.github.io/evolnets/reference/read_history.md)
  : Read history.txt file produced by RevBayes
- [`read_tree_from_revbayes()`](https://maribraga.github.io/evolnets/reference/read_tree_from_revbayes.md)
  : Read symbiont tree file produced by RevBayes containing node indices
- [`support_for_modules()`](https://maribraga.github.io/evolnets/reference/support_for_modules.md)
  : Calculate support for modules from summary networks based on modules
  of sampled networks
